title: 7th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/3/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: continuation of the debate on the petition forwarded by the Petitions Committee (under Standing Order 257-13) calling for the cancellation of the expensive health insurance that MPs receive but ordinary citizens do not.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Income Tax Act (Law No. 25/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011), submitted on behalf of the government by Kolamaafushi MP Ibrahim Didi.
First reading of the Bill to amend the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.
Preliminary debate on the Diplomatic Missions, Consular Posts and Privileges of International Organisations Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on its review of the Auditor General's Office budget for 2027.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to continue the debate on the petition to scrap MPs' health insurance, introduce three government tax-law amendment bills, debate the diplomatic privileges bill, and take up the committee report on the Auditor General's 2027 budget.
